title: CrowdStrike Falcon content update outage
summary: A faulty Falcon sensor content update caused widespread Windows crashes and operational disruption for customers relying on the endpoint agent update channel.

title: Change Healthcare ransomware / clearinghouse disruption
summary: Ransomware against Change Healthcare disrupted claims and payment clearing for a large share of U.S. healthcare transactions — a textbook concentration / intermediary failure.

title: Clorox cyberattack via service-desk social engineering
summary: Attackers reportedly used social engineering against an IT service desk pathway; manufacturing and retail availability were heavily disrupted for weeks.

title: SolarWinds Orion supply-chain compromise
summary: Nation-state actors inserted malicious code into Orion updates, compromising customers who installed the tainted builds.

title: MOVEit Transfer mass exploitation
summary: Exploitation of Progress MOVEit Transfer led to large-scale data theft across organizations that depended on the file-transfer product — including via third-party processors.

title: Okta support-system compromise
summary: Compromise of an Okta support system raised identity-provider concentration risk for customers relying on Okta for authentication.

title: Microsoft Exchange Server Hafnium exploitation
summary: Zero-day exploitation of on-premises Exchange servers demonstrated how a ubiquitous enterprise platform becomes a shared third-party-style dependency risk.

title: SAP RECON / critical ERP exposure patterns
summary: Critical SAP vulnerabilities (including RECON-class issues in prior years and ongoing ERP internet exposure research) illustrate how ERP platforms concentrate operational and data risk when internet-facing or poorly segmented.

title: Oracle Cloud / EBS historical exposure research
summary: Public research and CVE history around Oracle E-Business Suite and related stacks highlight ERP as a high-impact dependency class when authentication or patching lags.
